Interface ServerMessage

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AvailableLobbiesMessage, ChangeAgeUpdateMessage, CurrPlayerUpdateMessage, DrawUpdateMessage, ErrorMessage, EventMessage, GameCreatedMessage, GameEndingUpdateMessage, GameJoinedMessage, LoginFailedMessage, LoginSuccessMessage, MoveUpdateMessage, NotifyDrawableMessage, NotifySkipMessage, PhaseUpdateMessage, PingMessage, QuitAckMessage, RankingResponseMessage, ReconnectionMessage, RequestLeaderboardUpdateMessage, ReturnToQueueUpdateMessage, ShowBoardMessage, StatsUpdateMessage, StatusUpdateMessage
public interface ServerMessage extends Serializable
Marker interface for all messages sent from the server to a client over a socket connection.

Each concrete implementation represents a distinct server-side event or response. The Visitor pattern is used for dispatch: the client-side reader calls accept(ServerMessageVisitor) with a ServerMessageVisitor, which then invokes the appropriate visit overload.
